001package com.streamconverter.path;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006/**
007 * Represents a hierarchical path for tree-like data structures (JSON, XML).
008 *
009 * <p>This class handles parsing and matching of path expressions in both JSON-style ("$.user.name")
010 * and XML-style ("user/name") formats. It converts path expressions into hierarchical segments for
011 * efficient matching during data processing.
012 */
013public class TreePath implements ITreeMatcher {
014
015  private final List<String> segments;
016  private final String originalPath;
017
018  // Private constructor for factory methods
019  private TreePath(String originalPath, List<String> segments) {
020    this.originalPath = originalPath;
021    this.segments = segments;
022  }
023
024  /**
025   * Creates a TreePath from an XML path expression.
026   *
027   * @param xmlPath the XML path expression (e.g., "user/name")
028   * @return TreePath instance
029   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xmlPath is null or invalid
030   */
031  public static TreePath fromXml(String xmlPath) {
032    if (xmlPath == null || xmlPath.isBlank()) {
033      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XML path cannot be null or empty");
034    }
035    String trimmedPath = xmlPath.trim();
036    List<String> segments = parseXmlPathToSegments(trimmedPath);
037    return new TreePath(trimmedPath, segments);
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Creates a TreePath from a JSON path expression.
042   *
043   * @param jsonPath the JSON path expression (e.g., "$.user.name")
044   * @return TreePath instance
045   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null or invalid
046   */
047  public static TreePath fromJson(String jsonPath) {
048    if (jsonPath == null || jsonPath.isBlank()) {
049      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON path cannot be null or empty");
050    }
051    String trimmedPath = jsonPath.trim();
052    List<String> segments = parseJsonPathToSegments(trimmedPath);
053    return new TreePath(trimmedPath, segments);
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Checks if current path matches the target path segments
058   *
059   * @param currentPath current path segments to match against
060   * @return true if paths match exactly
061   */
062  @Override
063  public boolean matches(List<String> currentPath) {
064    return segments.equals(currentPath);
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Returns the original path expression.
069   *
070   * @return the original path expression
071   */
072  @Override
073  public String toString() {
074    return originalPath;
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * 2つのTreePathが等しいかどうかをセグメントリストで比較する。
079   *
080   * <p>注意: 元のパス文字列（{@link #toString()} の値）が異なっていても、セグメントに展開した結果が同じであれば等しいとみなす。 例えば JSONスタイルの {@code
081   * "$.user.name"} と XMLスタイルの {@code "user/name"} がパース後に同じセグメントになる場合、 等しいと判定される。
082   *
083   * @param obj 比較対象のオブジェクト
084   * @return セグメントリストが等しい場合true
085   */
086  @Override
087  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
088    if (this == obj) {
089      return true;
090    }
091    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
092      return false;
093    }
094    TreePath treePath = (TreePath) obj;
095    return segments.equals(treePath.segments);
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * セグメントリストに基づくハッシュコードを返す。
100   *
101   * @return ハッシュコード
102   */
103  @Override
104  public int hashCode() {
105    return segments.hashCode();
106  }
107
108  // === Internal Implementation ===
109
110  private static List<String> parseJsonPathToSegments(String jsonPath) {
111    if ("$".equals(jsonPath)) {
112      return new ArrayList<>();
113    }
114
115    String rest;
116    if (jsonPath.startsWith("$.")) {
117      rest = jsonPath.substring(2);
118    } else if (jsonPath.startsWith("$")) {
119      rest = jsonPath.substring(1);
120    } else {
121      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON path format: " + jsonPath);
122    }
123
124    return splitStrippingBrackets(jsonPath, rest);
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Splits a JSON path fragment on dots, skipping bracket sections (e.g. {@code [*]}, {@code [0]}).
129   * Uses character-by-character scanning to avoid regex backtracking.
130   *
131   * @param originalPath the full original JSON path (e.g. {@code $.users[*]}) for error messages
132   * @param path the fragment after stripping the {@code $} prefix
133   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if an unclosed {@code [} is found
134   */
135  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CyclomaticComplexity")
136  private static List<String> splitStrippingBrackets(String originalPath, String path) {
137    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
138    StringBuilder segment = new StringBuilder();
139    int bracketStart = -1;
140    for (int i = 0; i < path.length(); i++) {
141      char c = path.charAt(i);
142      if (c == '[') {
143        bracketStart = i;
144      } else if (c == ']') {
145        bracketStart = -1;
146      } else if (bracketStart < 0) {
147        if (c == '.' && !segment.isEmpty()) {
148          result.add(segment.toString());
149          segment.setLength(0);
150        } else if (c != '.') {
151          segment.append(c);
152        }
153      }
154    }
155    if (bracketStart >= 0) {
156      int position = originalPath.length() - path.length() + bracketStart;
157      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
158          "Invalid JSON path \"" + originalPath + "\": unclosed '[' at position " + position);
159    }
160    if (!segment.isEmpty()) {
161      result.add(segment.toString());
162    }
163    return result;
164  }
165
166  private static List<String> parseXmlPathToSegments(String xmlPath) {
167    // Remove leading and trailing slashes without regex to avoid polynomial complexity
168    String normalizedPath = removeLeadingTrailingSlashes(xmlPath);
169    if (normalizedPath.isEmpty()) {
170      return new ArrayList<>();
171    }
172
173    // Split by single slash and filter empty segments to handle multiple consecutive slashes
174    List<String> segments = new ArrayList<>();
175    int start = 0;
176    for (int i = 0; i <= normalizedPath.length(); i++) {
177      if (i == normalizedPath.length() || normalizedPath.charAt(i) == '/') {
178        if (i > start) {
179          segments.add(normalizedPath.substring(start, i));
180        }
181        start = i + 1;
182      }
183    }
184
185    return segments;
186  }
187
188  /**
189   * Removes leading and trailing slashes from path without regex
190   *
191   * @param path the input path
192   * @return path with leading/trailing slashes removed
193   */
194  private static String removeLeadingTrailingSlashes(String path) {
195    if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) {
196      return "";
197    }
198
199    int start = 0;
200    int end = path.length();
201
202    // Remove leading slashes
203    while (start < end && path.charAt(start) == '/') {
204      start++;
205    }
206
207    // Remove trailing slashes
208    while (end > start && path.charAt(end - 1) == '/') {
209      end--;
210    }
211
212    return path.substring(start, end);
213  }
214}
